questionText:
Match the artistic landmark in List I with its description in List II:

List I:
(A) Chand Bibi Playing Polo
(B) Ibrahim Adil Shah II with Tanpura
(C) Nujum al-Ulum (1570 A.D.)
(D) Sultan Abdullah Qutb Shah

List II:
(I) Bijapur astronomical and astrological treatise with hundreds of colored illustrations
(II) Golconda equestrian painting showing four noble women playing polo on galloping steeds
(III) Master portrait showing the Bijapur sultan in mystical reverie playing a stringed tanpura
(IV) Golconda ruler whose opulent, courtly portraiture showcased diamond-encrusted wealth

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-III, C-II, D-I

Chand Bibi Playing Polo is Golconda's equestrian work; Ibrahim with Tanpura is Bijapur's mystic portrait; Nujum al-Ulum is the 1570 Bijapur treatise; Abdullah Qutb Shah ruled Golconda.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
